subject: Part 2b: integrate LLM grader into agentic search loop
description: Integrate the Part 2a grader into runAgenticContextSearches (lib/subconscious/index.js), replacing the heuristic loop control (chooseAgenticFollowup + agenticStopReason + the evidence_quality<0.18 gate, index.js:665-714) with the LLM controller: the LLM decides continue/stop, the next reformulated query, keep/abstain, and the final aggregate. Keep the heuristic ranker as a CHEAP PREFILTER (top-N candidates) feeding the LLM, never the final arbiter. Cost controls: hard round cap, only invoke the LLM on the prefiltered set, feature-flag the whole path with heuristic fallback. Must benefit from Part 1b structural results when present. Add tests (mocked backend) asserting the loop calls the grader and respects its decisions. Files: lib/subconscious/index.js, routes/subconscious.js. Blocked by Part 1b + Part 2a.

summary:
Integrated the #3 LLM grader into the agentic search loop as an ADDITIVE floor-preserving controller (lib/subconscious/index.js, test/subconscious.test.js; commit 69f68311 on orch/attempt/.../4).

HOOK POINT: runAgenticContextSearches now runs the heuristic base loop UNCHANGED to completion (building the guaranteed floor = single-shot top-k + #2 structural neighbors), then runs a bounded grader EXTENSION phase on top — the grader controls continue/nextQuery and produces keep-by-intent + aggregate, but never redirects the floor's rounds. composeSearchContextEnvelope unions grader-kept candidates with the floor (superset-or-equal, never shrinks) and bypasses the final-confidence abstain gate on the grader path, so the 0.346 abstention regression cannot recur; grader abstain = "nothing to ADD", never empties.

FLOOR ENFORCEMENT: floor is identical to today's heuristic output by construction (base loop untouched); the grader only adds. Backend-error / parse-failure degrades cleanly to the floor.

NO WEDGE: per-round grader uses in-process api-kind backend (createDefaultGraderBackend / injected ctx.graderBackend), never a spawning agentic-cli sidecar; rerank stays #5's cooldown-guarded call. Only the cheap heuristic top-N prefilter is graded.

FLAG + ROUND CAP: whole path feature-flagged OFF by default (store graderEnabled / env ORCH_SEARCH_GRADER / per-request use_grader) with clean fallback to the existing heuristic loop. Hard grader round cap graderMaxRounds (default 4, env ORCH_GRADER_MAX_ROUNDS, ceiling 6), also bounded by the planner budget.

FOREGROUND TESTS (mocked backend, blocking): 5 new grader-integration tests all PASS — (a) loop invokes grader & respects continue/nextQuery/kept/aggregate; (b) returned set superset-or-equal to heuristic floor; (c) grader abstain keeps the floor; (d) round cap holds under a runaway grader; (e) backend failure degrades to floor.
